- [USER] User is interested in unique shopping experiences in Bandung.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bandung is known for being a factory outlet (FO) paradise with many factory outlets selling local and international brands at discounted prices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pasar Baru is Bandung's oldest and largest traditional market, selling clothing, accessories, food, and home goods.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Braga Street is a historic street lined with old colonial buildings turned into trendy cafes, restaurants, and boutique shops.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cihampelas Walk (Ciwalk) is famous for its denim street, offering a wide range of denim products.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dago Street is home to many boutiques, art galleries, and cafes, popular among young and trendy shoppers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Rumah Mode is a popular factory outlet known for its Balinese-inspired architecture and stylish clothing and accessories.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kartika Sari is a bakery famous for its chocolate brownies and other Indonesian snacks.
